# Papel picado banner

> Keystone test fixture: a faithful minimal sheet cartridge. Replaced by a real commons
> cartridge when the sheet commons is first pinned.

One flag of a papel picado string. Papel picado is the papercut tradition credited to
San Salvador Huixcolotla, Puebla; this fixture generates a symmetric motif rather than
copying any maker's design, and the manifest's `hyperobject.heritage` block names the
tradition, the region, the community and its sources.

| Parameter | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `width`, `height` | flag size, mm |
| `symmetry` | one fold (mirror) or two folds (quarters) |
| `hem` | depth of the fold-over hem the string runs through, mm |
